name: comp-477

frames.best_why: Every row and the header ticked, so both the selection and the footer total are visible.

tagline: Checkbox table of accounts with flag emojis, status pills and a running total.
summary: A dark table of five accounts, each row starting with a checkbox. Columns cover name, email, country flag and city, a status pill, and a right-aligned balance, with a total row underneath.
appearance: A thin white-lined table on near-black, led by a narrow checkbox column. Names are bold, locations begin with a small waving flag emoji, statuses sit in rounded pills (green for Active, grey for Inactive), and money lines up at the right. A divider separates a Total row.
behaviour: Ticking a row's box marks that row selected; the header box selects or clears every row at once. The header box shows a dash while only some rows are chosen, and the footer total follows the loaded data.
demo_content: Five accounts with cities, flags and balances, captioned "Basic data table made with TanStack Table".
search_phrases: table with checkboxes to select rows
select all rows in a data table
team accounts table with country flags
status badges inside a user table
table with running total row at bottom
admin list of people and balances
grid of rows with tick boxes and totals
use_when: People pick several rows to act on together and need a footer total for the loaded records.
avoid_when: Rows come from a remote JSON, so the table stays empty until that request finishes.
customise: Column definitions, the fetch URL and the five-row limit are written in the file; changing the data source, columns or currency means editing the source.
weight_why: A table library builds the grid over five remote rows; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Row and select-all checkboxes have aria labels and work from the keyboard; status is spelled out in the badge text.

issues: Rows are fetched from a remote URL, so offline the body reads "No results."
The demo caption credits the table library instead of describing the example.
polish_why: Crisp flags, clear status pills and working totals, on otherwise default table styling.
